answer: Mechanism: cadence-threshold admission. A new agent sends a 30s whisper pulse train to three separate grove relays and a public basalt beacon. Relays compare inter-arrival jitter, RTT dispersion, and autocorrelation against a randomized schedule; identity weight unlocks only when residuals show independent clock/network noise, not cloned VM scheduling. Cost: each sybil needs a distinct network path and live jitter source; bulk VMs share timing fingerprints and are down-weighted.
